einzeiler: How the pay-what-you-want business model works in unexpected places.
kurzfassung: The episode explores the pay-what-you-want business model used by various entrepreneurs and artists. Guests discuss their experiences implementing this pricing strategy in unusual settings. Additionally, a marketing professor examines why this approach challenges traditional economic theory.
stichpunkte: Application of the pay-what-you-want model by entrepreneurs and artists
Perspectives from a Brooklyn coffee house owner, a musician, and a creative reuse shop owner
Insights from a marketing professor on why the model confuses economists
beschreibung:
The pay-what-you-want business model is mostly found in museums and churches, but this week we’ll hear from entrepreneurs and artists who are implementing it in unlikely places. Guests include: Katie Bishop, owner of Principles G.I. Coffee House in Brooklyn, musician Jeff Rosenstock of Bomb the Music Industry!, and Aimé Nuñez, owner of Pegasus Creative Reuse in Dallas.
We also hear from Shelle Santana, assistant professor of marketing at Bentley University, who studies the PWYW model and tells Anna why its success is so confusing to economists.
Podcast production by Cameron Drews.
